reason: A QQ C2C integration plugin that bridges private messages, attachments, persistent per-user agent sessions, and agent replies through the QQ official bot gateway.

summaries.zh: 将 QQ 官方机器人私聊消息、图片附件和智能体会话连接起来，并把智能体回复发送回 QQ 用户。
summaries.en: Bridges QQ official bot private messages and image attachments to persistent per-user agent sessions, then sends agent replies back to QQ users.

capabilities: Receives QQ private messages through the QQ gateway
Maps each QQ user to a persistent agent session
Downloads image attachments to a local agent workspace
Sends agent text replies back to QQ users
Uploads and sends local images to QQ users
Stores session mappings and message-summary logs locally
Uses QQ bot credentials and maintains WebSocket connections with automatic reconnection
